description: Compare a and b by SemVer precedence (prereleases sort before the release, build metadata ignored). Returns -1, 0 or 1 and the change type from the lower to the higher version (major, minor, patch, premajor, preminor, prepatch, prerelease) exactly like semver.diff. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/compare.

a.description: First version: a semantic version such as "1.4.2", "v2.0.0" or "3.0.0-rc.1+build.5".

b.description: Second version: a semantic version such as "1.4.2", "v2.0.0" or "3.0.0-rc.1+build.5".

name: compare_versions
title: Compare two semantic versions
